# garage_cluster_health (Data Source)

Read Garage cluster health metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_health" "current" {}

output "cluster_status" {
  value = data.garage_cluster_health.current.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connected_nodes` (Number) Number of connected nodes.
- `known_nodes` (Number) Number of known nodes.
- `partitions` (Number) Total number of partitions.
- `partitions_all_ok` (Number) Partitions with all replicas available.
- `partitions_quorum` (Number) Partitions with write quorum.
- `status` (String) Health status: healthy, degraded, or unavailable.
- `storage_nodes` (Number) Number of storage nodes.
- `storage_nodes_ok` (Number) Number of healthy storage nodes.
